notes.title: The Infernal Update Is Out!
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We're glad to see many of you have been enjoying the game since our launch a few weeks ago.

Today we are releasing the Infernal update, which adds a new mode that is unlocked by completing the base game on any difficulty. When playing infernal mode your health and damage remain the same as on normal mode, but every attack in the game has been updated or reworked entirely to be much more challenging.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43682351/6cdfba8b9fbe681d8638c0d191866bee931d431b.png[/img]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43682351/b9a080da76513f6919768602da125ffb660fdf8c.png[/img]

For those of you who are brave enough to take on this new challenge, we have added new achievement's (and a death counter) to show off your accomplishments.

Thank you for all your support,

JustMakeGames

notes.title: Release Date Update
notes.content:
Hello Everyone,

We are making this post to update everyone on the release of Infernal Elements. Unfortunately the game is still under review by Steam Support and we have not gotten any updates at this time. 

Because of this, we have no option other than to delay the launch of the game a week, which will change our release date to [b]Friday, May 17th[/b].

We are sorry the game was not able to be released at the planned time of May 10th. We are doing everything we can to get our game approved as quick as possible, and we hope we can deliver the best game we can!

Thank you for your patience as we wrap up our development,

JustMakeGames

notes.title: Next Fest is here!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43682351/125ff60f69d82ab8fbbf52be3a2b0482f2f4e651.jpg[/img]


[h1]Thank you to everyone who was wishlisted our game so far! [/h1]

It has been a long journey working on Infernal Elements with lots of twists and turns, but we are happy to announce we have a playable demo in preparation for next fest! As we continue to wrap up the development of our game, expect more announcements about the official release date and more information about the game! If you have any feedback you would like us to know, feel free to reach out to us at justmakegamesdev@gmail.com


We also now have controller support for our demo to those who got a chance to check it out previously!!!
